name: retarget-bot
args:
from pathlib import Path
text = Path("/app/telegram_delivery.py").read_text()
bases = ("BASE='http://10.250.0.2:8082'", "BASE='http://socrat-bot.socrat-bot.svc:8080'")
matches = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("BASE=")]
if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0] not in bases or "Request(BASE+path," not in text:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected bot URL construction")
text = text.replace(matches[0], "BASE='https://bot.socrat.alchemmist.xyz/api'", 1)
old = "'X-Internal-Token':self.token"
if old not in text or "https://bot.socrat.alchemmist.xyz/api" not in text:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected bot client format")
Path("/patch/telegram_delivery.py").write_text(text.replace(old, "'Authorization':'Bearer '+self.token"))
